full_judgment: 10. PW 2 Md. Nurul Islam stated in his evidence that on the date of occurrence at about 6-30 PM he was sitting on a bench in front of the shop of Ansar Ali Kazi along with PW 1 Amanullah, PW 3 Delwar Hossain, PW 5 Kalachand and PW 8 Hashem and that place of occurrence was 10 or 12 cubits away from the shop of Ansar Ali. He continued to state in his evidence that when victim Rafiq came out from his Khala's house and was crossing the bridge he raised alarm saying "save me, save me" and at that time appellants with others being armed with deadly weapons like dagger, dao, jury, spear and chain of rickshaw attacked Rafiq and assaulted him. He further stated that appellant Ataur Rahman dealt dagger blows causing injuries on victim's neck and face and appellant Nurul Siddique dealt lathi blow on the head of the victim Rafiq. Amir Hossain dealt dagger blow on the left side of the chest of victim Rafiq. Mofazzel dealt chain blow on various parts of the body of victim Rafiq and appellant Siddique dealt spear blow on the right leg and appellant Mofazzel dealt a dagger blow and caused bleeding injury on the lip of the victim: He further stated that when Kalachand proceeded to rescue victim Rafique appellant Nurul Haque  dealt a katra blow (spear) ) on the abdomen of Kalachand causing serious injury and because of that blow his intestine came out. Thereafter people raised alarm and the appellants along with others fled away from the place of occurrence. He further stated that victim Rafiq succumbed to the injury on his way to hospital and that Kalachand was shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital where he stayed one month 10 days for medical treatment. He further stated that victim Rafiq sustained as many as 14 injuries on his person. He further stated that at the order of Ramizuddin appellants and others assaulted the victim. He also stated in his evidence that Rafiq played a prominent role in evicting Ramizuddin from Khas land of the government. His evidence has been substantially corroborated on all material particulars and the role played by each appellant in causing injury on the person of victim Rafiq.
